blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Defending champion University of the Visayas (UV) Green Lancers asserted their dominance, routing newcomer University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu/Mandaue (UCLM) Webmasters, 95-63, in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament at the Cebu Coliseum on Tuesday, September 22. UV sniper AJ Sacayan led the charge, firing 20 points highlighted by five three-pointers to power the Lancers to their third straight victory against one loss.
